measurementNotes: Only cache misses. Historical samples are reported tool-phase totals (lower bounds on composite tasks); API lint 135.859 and 407.816 are complete task durations. The 407.816 sample is from run 38204066394, job 114667162912; Oxlint completed 6516 files in 406.4 seconds. Root 32.797 bounds a complete task. Budgets include at least 30 seconds above max(1.5 x empirical p95, 2 x largest cold sample), rounded up, except the unchanged default bucket. Sparse-sample p95 is not a population estimate. Cached replay is excluded. Declaration producer: run 38312922554 job 115024830651 reports exact completed cache-miss execution 97.393 s. Runs 38285899521 job 114934635714 and 38285897370 job 114934624094 report completed cold producer-phase upper bounds 27.481 s and 24.207 s respectively (the producer is MISS; grouped logs include prerequisite overhead). The 225 s producer budget uses the existing formula over these three observations; phase bounds are conservative, not exact task timings. Latest #5636/#5639 marker-reuse runs skipped generation and are excluded.
planningMeasurementNotes: Completed intervals from generator/toolchain completion to the first code-check label include module startup, Git, affected-workspace discovery and optional lint planning. They are upper bounds on a planner command, not direct Turbo timings. The planner cap uses twice the largest completed bound plus the existing 30-second measurement margin, rounded up. Interrupted intervals are excluded.
